claims.text: The hotel is set on the trunk of Dubai's Palm.

findings.quote: Set on the trunk of Dubai's famous palm

claims.text: Being at the base of the Palm means easier access to the rest of Dubai than some competitors on the island.

findings.quote: A luxurious resort at the base of the famous palm means easier access to the rest of Dubai than some of its competitors on the island.

claims.text: The hotel has its own beach.

findings.quote: With its own impressive beach and large rooms with views

claims.text: All rooms have large balconies with furniture.

findings.quote: All rooms have large balconies with furniture

claims.text: Bathrooms have blue mosaics set against tan marble, deep tubs, separate showers and Le Labo toiletries.

findings.quote: Bathrooms, decorated with blue mosaics set against tan marble, are a little dated. Regardless, they're still luxurious with deep tubs, separate showers, and Le Labo toiletries.

claims.text: One of the four pools is specifically for families.

findings.quote: One of the four pools is specifically for families.

claims.text: Restaurants include a Brazilian steakhouse and Chinese fine dining.

findings.quote: including a Brazilian steakhouse and Chinese fine dining

claims.text: Frevo is a Brazilian restaurant where meats are carved tableside in southern Brazilian style.

findings.quote: Frevo is an authentic Brazilian restaurant where meats are carved tableside in true southern Brazilian style.

claims.text: The Signature Jacuzzi Suite has a private balcony with a jacuzzi overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

findings.quote: a private balcony with a jacuzzi ovelooking breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf

claims.text: Deluxe rooms have views of the Palm and the Dubai Marina skyline and a private balcony.

findings.quote: breathtaking views of the Palm and the Dubai Marina skyline make this one of our most sought after rooms. Enjoy the sunset from your private balcony.

claims.text: The Fairmont Serenity Room faces the Palm sea and includes access to the Thermal Oasis, a wellness breakfast by Zest served in the room and 30% off massages at Serenity Spa.

findings.quote: Find tranquility with our palm sea facing room by Serenity Spa, which includes access to the Thermal Oasis, a wellness breakfast by Zest served in the room, signature wellness minibar amenities, and 30% off on massages at Serenity Spa.

claims.text: The Family 3 Bedroom Deluxe Palm Sea View Suite has three bedrooms, a walk-in wardrobe, marble bathrooms, a dining and lounge area and a kitchenette.

findings.quote: This spacious family suite with its Arabic touches, offers 3 bedrooms, a walk-in wardrobe, marble bathrooms, a dining and lounge area, kitchenette

claims.text: One and two bedroom apartments are located within the hotel, with a fully equipped kitchen and access to the gym, outdoor pools, private beach and kids club.

findings.quote: Located within the hotel, our classic one bedroom apartments offer a fully equipped kitchen, dining space and views of the Palm residences with access to all hotel facilities including gym, outdoor pools, private beach and kids club.

claims.text: Fairmont Gold rooms and suites give access to the Fairmont Gold lounge, which has sea views and offers breakfast, afternoon tea, happy hour and evening canapés.

findings.quote: providing access to the luxury of Fairmont Gold lounge with its stunning sea views, featuring breakfast, afternoon tea, happy hour and evening canapés.

claims.text: Rooms facing the road deal with traffic noise.

findings.quote: beware that rooms facing the road deal with traffic noise

claims.text: Wi-Fi in the rooms is expensive; it is free in public areas but does not reach the beach or pool areas.

findings.quote: Wifi is expensive (and of marginal quality) in the rooms. It’s free in public areas, but doesn’t reach to the beach or pool areas.
Restaurants are expensive, but there's lots of variety
